item.title: Tradeoff-Aware Territory Design: A Multi-Objective Decision System for Enterprise Customer-to-Seller Allocation
item.description: arXiv:2610.31701v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise customer journeys are shaped not only by product experiences and marketing, but also by recurring resource-allocation decisions. In B2B go-to-market (GTM) organizations, territory carving determines which accounts receive seller coverage, which seller-account relationships are preserved, and how limited field capacity is distributed. Yet the process often remains manual, making it difficult to compare opportunities, value continuity, and evaluate tradeoffs among growth, balance, capacity, and feasibility. We present a production decision system for tradeoff-aware customer-to-seller allocation in enterprise GTM planning. It integrates three components: a multidimensional account-value layer that combines predictive signals to score opportunity; an observational continuity-valuation layer that estimates the cost of breaking seller-account relationships using a synthetic-control-style counterfactual framework; and a multi-objective optimization layer that allocates coverage to high-value accounts while considering continuity, opportunity balance, and operational constraints. Deployed as a scenario-based decision-support system, the framework enables planners to inspect and compare allocation tradeoffs. Historical backtesting shows that optimizer-generated scenarios substantially improve assignment compliance while maintaining comparable seller-level opportunity distribution. In production planning, adopted scenarios improved both assignment compliance and opportunity balance relative to the previous baseline. Directing scarce seller capacity toward higher-value accounts also offers incremental revenue potential at enterprise scale. The key contribution is an integrated, inspectable framework that turns territory carving into a governable decision process.

item.title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
item.description: arXiv:2610.31789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific computing increasingly relies on large language model-based agents for performance engineering tasks such as instrumentation, analysis, and workflow porting. However, agent effectiveness depends heavily on the surrounding harness, which typically relies on manually written skills and curated memory. This limits autonomous learning, forcing agents to repeatedly rediscover solutions rather than retain and reuse knowledge from prior executions. We introduce Phronix, a capability-centric learning paradigm that enables agentic harnesses to acquire, validate, and refine reusable capabilities from their own executions. Phronix operates through a predictor-validator-corrector loop: MCP tools and associated skills propose solutions, tool executions validate them, and observed outcomes refine the stored capabilities. It distills every observed interaction into a capability store and researches a failing task rather than abandoning it. First, such learned capabilities solve a recurring task on the first attempt in 93-95% of cases across every model, significantly reducing solution non-determinism and improving reliability. Second, Phronix turns an agent's own execution into 7.6-30.8 durable capabilities per task without user instruction, and creation falls below two once the needed capability exists. Third, warm-start runs consume only 0.38-0.40 million tokens per task, which is three to four times less than a single baseline attempt, while a cold-start costs no more than the baseline. On the 1000 Genome Pegasus workflow, instrumenting a production application for I/O performance analysis, Phronix passes all 11 correctness checks against six for the baseline harness, and also lifts the task solving rates of two cheaper models from 29% and 27% of SWE-bench tasks solved to 91% and 87%, respectively, matching the performance of the most expensive evaluated model.

item.title: Patronizing and Condescending Language Detection in English and Mandarin
item.description: arXiv:2610.31808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Patronizing and condescending language (PCL) is a form of harmful language that belittles and assumes pity for vulnerable groups, reinforcing negative societal stereotypes. However, unlike overt hate speech, it is often difficult to detect, even for human judges. This paper proposes a system for the automated detection of PCL. Our first approach uses static word embeddings and a convolutional neural network for classification, while our second approach uses pre-trained BERT embeddings fine-tuned for the PCL task. Our second approach was considerably more successful, and achieved an F1 score of 0.528 over the development set.

item.title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
item.description: arXiv:2610.31810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version. Starting from the LaTeX source, PaperFormalizer transcribes the paper into a dependency graph of statements, audits each statement in natural language for faithfulness, ambiguity and correctness, and then formalizes and proves the statements in Lean against Mathlib, optional domain libraries and the author's personal toolkit. Only the author knows what a statement is meant to say and how a formalization gap in a result is best fixed. The pipeline therefore stops and asks the author whenever a statement admits more than one reading, presents every repair, in natural language and TeX symbols, as a proposal that the author can accept, decline or redirect, and leaves to the author every decision that could potentially change what the paper claims. The output is an annotated and revised version of the paper, a report of the changes, and Lean code in which each declaration is linked to the statement it formalizes. The author's toolkit grows as more papers are formalized, and authors can share their verified papers so that researchers who build on them can reuse their Lean code. By making verified papers practical to produce, PaperFormalizer aims to make research that rests on mathematical proofs more robust. PaperFormalizer runs inside a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) and is available at https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/PaperFormalizer. Papers with Lean code shared by users are available at https://paperformalizer.org.

item.title: Phonon evidence for a partial, re-entrant spin reorientation near room temperature in LaFe$_{1-x}$Ni$_x$O$_3$
item.description: arXiv:2610.31725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin reorientation near room temperature offers a route to controlling antiferromagnetic order, yet LaFeO$3$, which lacks a magnetic rare-earth ion, is generally expected to retain its spin orientation along the $a$ axis below $T{\mathrm N}\approx740$~K. Here, we investigate LaFe$_{1-x}$Ni$_x$O$_3$ ($x=0$ and 0.1) using temperature-dependent magnetization and Raman spectroscopy over 200--400~K. Both compositions exhibit magnetic anomalies at 285.6 and 323~K, respectively, accompanied by correlated deviations of 12 Raman modes from their conventional anharmonic behavior. Principal component analysis and a global fitting approach reveal a common temperature-dependent phonon response, with mode-dependent amplitudes and signs. To interpret these anomalies, we develop a Landau-based spin-phonon coupling model describing complete, partial re-entrant, and incipient spin reorientation. Comparison with the experimental Raman profiles favors a partial, re-entrant rotation of the N'eel vector in both compositions, centered near 290~K. Ni substitution narrows the characteristic reorientation interval from approximately 116 to 84~K and enhances the magnetization anomaly by a factor of four. An additional feature near 262~K in LaFeO$_3$ is consistent with the Morin transition of trace $\alpha$-Fe$_2$O$_3$. These findings suggest that partial spin reorientation can emerge without magnetic rare-earth ions and establish collective Raman phonon anomalies as a sensitive indirect probe of magnetic anisotropy changes in orthoferrites.

item.title: Nonadiabatic vibrational dynamics of CO on Pt(111) studied with first-principles many-body perturbation theory
item.description: arXiv:2610.31727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the nonequilibrium vibrational dynamics of CO adsorbed on Pt(111), a prototypical adsorbate-surface system for ultrafast vibrational spectroscopy, using a first-principles framework that combines many-body perturbation theory with density functional theory. Within this methodology we explicitly account for electron-hole pair excitations and electron-mediated phonon-phonon coupling. For the latter mechanism, we evaluate the vertex-correction screening, what constitutes a methodological novelty. Our calculations qualitatively reproduce the transient evolution of the internal stretch vibrational mode observed in femtosecond pump-probe experiments, allowing us to identify in the experimental measurements a small transient blueshift after excitation with a femtosecond laser pulse. As predicted in a previous work, the reduction in the number of electronic states available for electron-phonon coupling when the electronic temperature raises at a group 10 transition metal surface, effectively screens the electron-phonon interaction giving rise to an anomalous transient blue-shift.

item.title: Altermagnetism in Folded Iron Chain Systems
item.description: arXiv:2610.31732v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism, a moment-compensated magnetism with momentum-dependent spin splitting, has so far been realized primarily in N\'{e}el-type antiferromagnets. Here, we demonstrate altermagnetism in folded iron-chain systems with block-type magnetic order (e.g., $\uparrow \uparrow \downarrow \downarrow$). In the strictly one-dimensional (1D) case, altermagnetism is forbidden by the $[C_2||{\cal T}]$ symmetry, but it can emerge when such chains are stacked into a quasi-1D array. To generate altermagnetic spin splitting via this chain-stacking mechanism, two essential ingredients are required: a block-type spin order that spontaneously breaks the combined parity-time reversal symmetry, and finite inter-chain hopping. Using first-principles calculations, we identify the K$_3$Fe$_2$Se$_4$ family as a promising platform that realizes this mechanism, hosting a $d$-wave altermagnet even without lattice $C_{4}$ symmetry. Moreover, owing to its lower symmetry, the block-type folded chain exhibits an isotropic altermagnetic spin splitting, which may manifest as an altermagnetic wrapping effect. Our findings unify real-space block magnetism and reciprocal-space altermagnetism, establishing folded iron chains as a tunable platform for zero-moment spintronic applications.

item.title: Thermoelectric properties and modulation doping of ultrawide-bandgap nitride monolayers
item.description: arXiv:2610.31777v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional III-nitride alloys provide a composition-tunable platform for exploring thermoelectric transport and intrinsic electric-field tolerance. We combine first-principles electronic-structure calculations with semiclassical transport for ordered monolayer B$_{x}$Al$_{1-x}$N and B$_{x}$Ga$_{1-x}$N. State-dependent momentum relaxation times computed with AMSET include acoustic deformation-potential and piezoelectric scattering. Using a common, temperature-independent lattice thermal conductivity of 550 W/mK, we predict maximum thermoelectric figure of merit ZT>2.5 for selected p- and n-type monolayers and ZT>2 at 300~K for n-type B$_{0.25}$Ga$_{0.75}$N. Composition-dependent band curvature, screening, and scattering help interpret the different p- and n-type responses. Vacuum-referenced band alignments identify candidate modulation-doping partners for both carrier types; explicit hGaN/V$_2$O$_5$ calculations yield a hole surface density of approximately 1.6$\times10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$. A separate phenomenological model using the band gap and maximum phonon frequency predicts intrinsic breakdown fields of 20.06 and 20.74 MVcm for the Al- and Ga-containing x=0.75 alloys, respectively. These results motivate further investigation for thermoelectric and high-field power-electronic applications. The ZT values apply to the specified scattering and lattice-conductivity models, while the breakdown estimates require validation for monolayers and do not resolve field direction.

item.title: Perfectly aperiodic asymmetric scalable metasurface based on the hat monotile
item.description: arXiv:2610.32467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metasurfaces are conventionally designed on periodic lattices, which renders their electromagnetic response spatially uniform and leaves the spatial arrangement itself unused as an information-bearing design resource. In this study, we propose and numerically validate a metasurface built on an aperiodic monotile: the recently discovered "hat" polykite, a single tile mathematically guaranteed to tile the plane only nonperiodically. The twelve distinguishable orientations of the hat serve as a natural design basis; each carries resonant elements tuned to one of twelve absorption frequencies between 4.600 and 4.914 GHz, transcribing the provable aperiodicity and mirror asymmetry of the geometry into the electromagnetic response. Gaussian-beam scanning over a compositionally unique 6 times 6 grid yields irregular, position-dependent electromagnetic signatures whose pairwise separations reach beyond 6 dB. In particular, coherence-guided selection of multiple frequencies increases the stable rank of the position-signature matrix from 1.0 to approximately 1.6 with three frequency components, whereas the accumulation of mutually similar electromagnetic features fails to add effective dimensions, demonstrating that properly selected multifrequency characteristics enhance the spatial distinguishability embedded in the surface. A shift-correlation analysis in which the cosine similarity never exceeds 0.5 confirms that the response inherits the absence of translational order from the tiling. Compatible with standard printed-circuit fabrication, the aperiodic metasurface design establishes a deterministic route toward position-identifiable electromagnetic environments for localization, chipless identification, and integrated sensing and communication.

item.title: The Extended Diode Equation
item.description: arXiv:2610.32090v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: For more than 75 years, the p-n junction current-voltage characteristic has been derived by treating majority carriers as an inert background and conflating the junction voltage with the applied bias. Here we show that the base electric field, generated by the coupling of excess majority and minority carriers, fundamentally alters the internal potential distribution. This self-consistent framework yields a closed-form extended diode equation that reproduces the high-injection roll-off without invoking an external series resistance, thereby eliminating an empirical patch that has persisted in the classical theory.

item.title: A Self-Consistent Two-Carrier Drift-Diffusion Framework for p-n Junctions: Extended Diode Equation, Power Dissipation, and Base Transit Time
item.description: arXiv:2610.32112v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The classical theory of p-n junctions derives the current-voltage characteristic from minority-carrier diffusion alone: majority carriers are treated as an inert background, the quasi-neutral base as field-free, and the junction voltage as equal to the applied bias. These premises fail together under high bias and high-level injection, where the observed current roll-off is reproduced only by appending an empirical series resistance outside the junction physics. Here we develop a self-consistent two-carrier drift-diffusion framework that introduces no assumption beyond the classical ones. Excess majority carriers are shown to be electrostatically forced transport participants: the ambipolar diffusion equation, closed by exact two-sided boundary conditions, yields a unified excess-carrier profile. The resulting base field separates into an ohmic and a Dember component, and all four current components follow in closed form, their sum being position independent. At device level the framework closes into an extended diode equation that contains the Shockley equation as its low-injection, long-base limit and reproduces the n=2 roll-off intrinsically. The junction voltage emerges as a self-limiting drop confined to the space-charge region and separated from the applied bias by exact base drops. Two device-level corrections are quantified: at high current, 75-90% of the dissipation migrates from the junction into the quasi-neutral base, and field-assisted acceleration shortens the base transit time by up to a factor of six. Three parameter-free predictions follow: a universal ideality-factor crossover that passes through 3/2 when the boundary excess equals the doping, a high-injection onset voltage that scales as 119 mV per decade of doping, and a geometry factor that survives into high injection.

item.title: Photon-Number Discrimination from Increasing Time-of-Arrival Separation in Wide Superconducting Microstrip Single-Photon Detectors
item.description: arXiv:2610.32154v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Measurements of photon-number-dependent time-of-arrival (TOA) distributions in wide NbN superconducting microstrip single-photon detectors (SMSPDs) are presented. Two \SI{10}{\um}-long devices with widths of \SI{3.2}{\um} and \SI{6.4}{\um} are characterized under pulsed \SI{515}{nm} excitation. The TOA histograms are described by sums of exponentially modified Gaussian (EMG) components, with the wider device exhibiting components assigned to photon numbers up to \(n=8\). Adjacent TOA peaks become more distinguishable relative to their widths at higher photon number, in contrast to the compression of neighboring photon-number timing shifts observed in conventional narrow-wire SNSPDs. For the components assigned to \(n=7\) and \(n=8\), the FWHM-normalized peak separation is \(2.15\), and the fitted EMG distributions yield an equal-prior pairwise TOA-assignment fidelity of \(99.6\%\). The EMG exponential-tail parameter \(\tau_n\) decreases strongly with photon number, while the Gaussian-location parameter \(\mu_n\) continues to shift between neighboring components. A phenomenological model motivated by absorption-site-dependent vortex processes and collective current redistribution captures these timing trends. These results support wide SMSPDs as a platform for TOA-based photon-number discrimination at high photon number, relevant to multiphoton-state characterization and photonic quantum information processing. The same geometry also provides a setting to examine how the spatial distribution of photon absorption affects vortex-assisted detection.

item.title: 全国多所财经高校布局“AI + 财经”
item.description: IT之家 10 月 26 日消息，据央视新闻今日报道，为推动财经教育数智化转型， 全国多所财经高校积极布局“AI+ 财经” ，探索 AI 赋能财经教育和研究转型升级。 在首都经济贸易大学，新成立的智能经济研究院正在对“融创智谷”平台进行升级。这是学校重点打造的“算力 — 算法 — 数据”一体化底座，通过统筹全校算力、共享数据资源，面向全校人才培养、科学研究和智库服务三类场景开放。 依托这一底座，学校持续推动教学方式和课程设置调整。 各学院可开发自己的垂类大模型和智能体，给不同专业配备不同的“智能助手” 。在人工智能学院的“词元经济”课堂，教学不再主要依托教材案例和历史数据，而是引入实时数据和智能交互，学生围绕真实经济问题开展实训。 同时，学校新成立的未来商学院、数字经济学院，也在借助 AI 重构人才培养模式，培养适应智能经济发展的复合型财经人才。 首都经济贸易大学副校长尹志超：“十五五”规划提出发展量子科技、脑机接口、具身智能等六大未来产业。未来的商科怎么样去支撑这些未来产业的发展，基于人工智能的这些技术和方法来研究未来产业发展的规律，对经营管理人才的需求，改造我们人才培养的模式，让我们培养的人才能够更好地适应这个时代的需求。 中央财经大学、上海财经大学 等多所财经高校也在加快学科调整和平台建设，探索“AI+ 财经”的新路径，推动财经学科与人工智能深度融合。

item.title: 比亚迪第二代海豹 07 盲订开启：定位 C 级全享家轿，轴距 2960mm
item.description: IT之家 10 月 26 日消息，比亚迪汽车海洋网销售事业部总经理张卓今日宣布，第二代海豹 07 盲订开启。 据介绍，盲订权益包含盲订臻享礼遇、优先排产提车以及自由选配三项内容。 IT之家获悉，新车提供帕拉青、极光粉、海雾紫、琉光银、雪域白以及曜石黑六款车色；云汐白、幻影灰、凝夜紫三种内饰配色可供选择；新车长宽高分别为 5080/1960/1495mm，轴距 2960mm。 内饰方面，第二代海豹 07 采用最新设计语言，搭载大尺寸悬浮中控屏，并配备液晶仪表；搭载全新三辐式方向盘，还搭载了 20 扬帝瓦雷音响。 座椅方面，第二代海豹 07 前排配备了零重力座椅，并提供按摩、通风及加热功能。其余配置方面，新车还搭载 618L 超大容积后备箱、160L 同级最大前备箱等。 工信部申报信息显示，新车提供纯电、插混两种动力版本可选： 纯电版本提供两种动力版本： 低功率版本峰值功率 245 kW ，额定功率 115 kW，整备质量 1975 kg； 高功率版本峰值功率 300 kW ，额定功率 150 kW，整备质量 2060 kg。 插混版本为 比亚迪海豹 07 DM-i ，采用插电式混合动力，搭载 1.5T 发动机，发动机最大净功率 110 kW，驱动电机为永磁同步电机，峰值功率 160 kW，额定功率 70 kW。 相关阅读： 《 比亚迪海豹 07 新车申报：提供纯电 / 插混动力，峰值功率 300 kW 》

item.title: 大学老师工资将通过数字人民币钱包发放，江苏多所高校收到通知
item.description: IT之家 10 月 26 日消息，扬州大学财务处 10 月 20 日发布通知，接省财政厅预通知， 自 2026 年 11 月起，学校在职在编人员（含人事代理）工资将通过数字人民币钱包发放 ，请相关人员根据自己目前的工资卡情况，于 10 月 23 日前完成数币钱包的开立与升级。 扬州大学财务处表示，工资将发放至开立的数币钱包中。学校在职在编人员（含人事代理）可以根据需要，自主选择是否将钱包里的钱兑换（转出）到原有的工资卡中。外籍人员目前无法开立数币钱包，暂不需要办理。 此外，南通大学财务处 10 月 23 日也发布通知，接省财政厅通知， 自 2026 年 11 月起全校在编人员、人事代理人员工资将通过数币钱包发放 。请相关人员于 10 月 30 日前完成数币钱包的开立与升级（工资、绩效分两张卡发放，两张均需开立）。外籍人员目前无法开立数币钱包，暂不需要办理。 综合IT之家此前报道，中国人民银行行长潘功胜在本月的 2026 金融街论坛年会上发言称，今年初，人民银行平稳切换了数字人民币新计量框架， 数字人民币定位由现金切换为存款货币 。 潘功胜还表示，去年在北京设立的数字人民币运营管理中心已全面投入运营，成为集发行管理、零售、批发、区块链、智能合约等服务为一体的综合性数字人民币业务平台。 数字人民币业务运营机构已从 10 家拓展至 30 家，覆盖全部系统重要性银行 。 数据显示，截至 2025 年 11 月末，数字人民币累计处理交易 34.8 亿笔，累计交易金额 16.7 万亿元。通过数字人民币 App 开立个人钱包 2.3 亿个，数字人民币单位钱包已开立 1,884 万个。多边央行数字货币桥（mBridge）累计处理跨境支付业务 4,047 笔，累计交易金额折合人民币 3,872 亿元，其中数字人民币在各币种交易额占比约 95.3%。

item.title: 苹果发 iPhone 折叠屏官方文档，排查铰链故障；触屏 MacBook 或周三发布；《流浪地球 3》将曝光，春节上映｜极客早知道
item.description: 张雪时隔 17 年圆梦「水上漂」，在家乡麻阳刷新吉尼斯纪录 10 月 25 日，「张雪机车」创始人张雪驾驶改装摩托车 MX450，在湖南省怀化市麻阳苗族自治县郭公坪镇小坡村，成功挑战「改装摩托车在开阔水域行驶最远距离」吉尼斯世界纪录。 这场挑战要追溯到 2009 年。当时 22 岁的张雪在央视节目中骑着一辆车轮上焊着铁皮的摩托车冲向水面，四次尝试全部落水，最远只滑出 20 米，离他自己定下的 26 米目标差了一口气。 本次用于挑战的「张雪机车」MX450，是专门为了应对水上滑行而改装的型号。据「张雪机车」研发工程师邓连松介绍，改装摩托车以标准摩托车车架和动力总成作为基础，技术团队进行了相应的优化升级。 麻阳是张雪的故乡，当地龙舟以逆水行舟而闻名。在张雪挑战成功之后，乡亲们以龙舟表演等方式为张雪团队庆祝胜利。（来源：新华网） OpenAI 前沿模型训练不再接入实时互联网，改用离线网页环境 10 月 24 日，OpenAI 公布前沿模型训练与评估环境的新安全措施：模型在训练中不再直接访问实时互联网，搜索和浏览任务改用预先索引、缓存的网页内容。这里限制的是训练中的模型，并不意味着 OpenAI 的训练基础设施完全断网；运行和监测实验仍需要部分外部连接。 这一调整与此前的安全事件有关。9 月，一款内部模型曾利用 DNS 配置缺口，在训练中获得有限的外网访问权限。此后，OpenAI 暂停相关训练 11 天，并让前沿模型智能体测试沙箱、虚拟机和网络防线。测试发现多处漏洞及配置问题，修复后，前沿模型的强化学习训练已于 10 月 1 日恢复。OpenAI 表示，今后仍会持续测试这些隔离措施。（来源：OpenAI） 苹果 iPhone Duo 在部分区域破发：已加入电商平台「百亿补贴」，相对上市价便宜约 200-300 元 10 月 25 日，综合各大平台网友反馈，苹果 iPhone Duo 在国内部分区域出现「破发」情况，同时当下拼多多已将该机上架百亿补贴频道（注：仅部分地区能看到），相对于上市价格便宜约 200-300 元。 虽然苹果 iPhone Duo 首发日被加价到 1500-2000 元，然而该机在发售 2 天后的当下就迎来了「破发」局面。尽管如此，目前苹果 Apple Store 全国多家门店依然没有提供可直接购买的现货，官网购买手机选择「送货」选项时，显示仍要等到明年 1 月。 行业研究机构 IDC 此前预计，苹果首款折叠屏 iPhone 首年出货量将超过 1000 万部，并可能在 2027 年拿下全球折叠屏手机市场约 40% 的份额。高盛则维持对 iPhone Duo 的乐观判断，预计其 2026 年出货可达 1300 万部，2027 年有望达到 3300 万部。（来源：IT 之家） 英伟达想靠软件持续收费，黄仁勋举例：每块 GPU 每年约 2000 美元 10 月 26 日，据媒体报道，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋近日在柏林 GTC 活动上表示，软件许可将成为公司越来越重要的收入来源。他以运行 AI 智能体的软件为例，提到按 GPU 数量收费的方式：每块 GPU 每年约 2000 美元。企业购买 GPU 建设数据中心后，还可能持续为运行和管理 AI 智能体的软件付费。 按这个价格计算，若有 500 万块 GPU 使用相关软件，一年便对应约 100 亿美元的许可收入。不过，2000 美元目前只是黄仁勋谈及收费模式时举出的数字。英伟达尚未公布适用产品、正式价格和实施时间，也不能据此认为所有购买英伟达 GPU 的客户都要额外支付这笔费用。（来源：cnBeta） 亚马逊 CEO 贾西： 2027 年 AWS 算力基本售罄，部分订单锁定到 2028 年 10 月 25 日，亚马逊首席执行官安迪·贾西表示，受 AI 基础设施需求持续走高的推动，亚马逊云科技（AWS）的云计算容量到 2027 年基本已经售罄，还有大量长期算力订单锁定到 2028 年。 今年早些时候，亚马逊公布，2026 年资本开支计划约 2200 亿美元（现汇率约合 1.47 万亿元人民币）。贾西提到，既然 2026 年的云算力容量已经全部订满，公司「其实还可以加大投入，继续加码并不是低效的资金使用方式」。 他说：「2027 年的算力容量基本售罄。我们会预留一部分资源，用于按需调用、推理服务 Bedrock 以及 EC2，但适合批量采购的大块算力资源大多已经被订走。2028 年也有相当一部分容量被提前锁定。」EC2 是 AWS 的云服务器服务，用来承载各类应用；Bedrock 则供客户调用 AI 模型，搭建生成式 AI 应用。（来源：IT 之家） 马斯克预告 X 平台新功能：长按点赞按钮，将通过 X Money 向对方转账 1 美元 10 月 25 日，马斯克在 X 平台发文宣布：将为「长按点赞」操作加入转账 1 美元（IT 之家注：现汇率约合 6.7 元人民币）功能，有关交易将会经由 X Money 完成。 不过，马斯克暂未透露这一功能的上线日期。 据悉，X Money 于 7 月下旬正式在美国上线，面向 Premium 和 Premium+ 订阅用户全量开放。X Money 将账户存款、点对点转账以及 Visa 借记卡功能整合在 X 应用内。用户可在 X 内即时向他人汇款、收款或请求收款，无手续费和限额。 随后在今年 9 月，X 平台宣布，美国地区创作者从「原创内容奖励计划」和创作者订阅获得的收益，今后统一通过其支付服务 X Money 发放。（来源：IT 之家） 彼得·蒂尔谈苹果：乔布斯之后「没做什么新东西」 10 月 25 日，据 Business Insider 报道，亿万富翁、PayPal 联合创始人、科技投资者彼得·蒂尔称，苹果在创始人史蒂夫·乔布斯2011 年因癌症去世之后「没做什么新东西」。 「在我看来，乔布斯之后它没做什么新东西，」蒂尔说，「事实证明，手机是一项巨大的发明——之后没有太多可做的了。然后就是规模化、品牌化，以及用 15 年左右或更长时间把它铺开。」 蒂尔并未完全否定苹果。他称苹果是一只「纯粹、运营良好的价值股」，但感叹乔布斯去世后愿景流失。「我仍会说，不知为何，埃隆或史蒂夫·乔布斯对社会远比蒂姆·库克更好，」他说。 苹果未立即回应置评请求。（来源：cnBeta） 长鑫存储拒绝苹果低价采购要求，优先推进中国内存自主化布局 10 月 25 日，此前有报道称，苹果希望从长鑫获得比现有供应商更低的报价，但长鑫没有接受降价要求。最新报道提到，一家台湾服务器厂商寻求采购长鑫的 DDR5 内存，同样未能达成合作。 在消费电子行业，供应商通常愿意通过降价换取苹果长期且规模可观的订单。然而在 DRAM 领域，长鑫存储却选择了另一条道路。报道称，该公司希望在与三星电子、SK 海力士和美光等国际存储巨头竞争的同时，将有限产能优先配置给中国客户，而非争取海外市场份额。 报道援引行业人士分析称，华为、小米等国内客户的需求已占据长鑫大量产能，因此它目前没有太大动力靠低价争取海外订单。不过，长鑫和苹果均未公开确认谈判细节；「优先推进自主化」也是外界对其商业选择的解读，并非公司宣布的策略。（来源：cnBeta） 国内首部 AI 院线长片《三星堆：未来往事》，票房过百万 10 月 25 日，猫眼专业版数据显示，《三星堆：未来往事》电影票房已达到 116.2 万。 《三星堆：未来往事》是国内首部获得国家电影局公映许可证的 AI 全流程院线长片，上映于 10 月 23 日。本片片长 100 分钟，所有角色均为原创数字形象，不含对真实演员的数字复制。 同时，本片故事设定在未来人类将一切决策交给算法而引发全球危机，破解困局的线索指向三星堆七个古老刻符，形成「答案在过去，危机在未来」的叙事结构。 这部影片的制作方式决定了它「首部」标签的实质含义。全片依托博纳自研的「博卡电影云片场」完成，创作团队历时两年，产出 120 余万张底图，完成上百次全片迭代。据官方介绍，AI 主要承担生成与执行，创意构思、剧本、镜头设计与审美判断由博纳 AIGMS 团队完成。团队参照传统剧组设置了编剧、导演、制片、美术、摄影、灯光、音效、剪辑等 17 个专业分工，参与人员近百人。（来源：IT 之家） 2026 InnoCIM 收官倒计时3天：青年创新力量，探索下一代计算 从大模型到芯片，下一代AI计算将如何演进？青年创新者正在给出自己的答案。 2026 InnoCIM存算一体高校挑战赛汇聚61所海内外高校、333位青年参赛者，诞生近百组技术创新作品。 10 月 28 日，杭州临平，赛事即将迎来收官！现场将发布青年创新者荣誉，六组优秀团队带来 Young Innovators Showcase 技术首秀，集中展示 MoE 权重调度、Attention 硬件加速、RRAM 随机存内计算等前沿探索，并通过 InnoCIM Demo Day 开启 AI 模型芯片部署实践。 从青年创新成果到产业技术交流，共同探索下一代计算的更多可能。（来源：极客公园） 古尔曼：苹果首款触屏 MacBook Pro 或于 10 月 29 日亮相 10 月 25 日，援引彭博社记者马克·古尔曼的消息，苹果首款触屏 MacBook Pro 预计于北京时间 10 月 29 日凌晨 1 点亮相。新机据称提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸两种尺寸，将首次为 MacBook Pro 配备 OLED 触控屏，并采用类似 iPhone 的「灵动岛」设计，售价可能高于现款高端机型。 报道称，触控不会取代键盘和触控板，而是用于滚动、缩放、滑动等适合直接操作屏幕的场景。为此，苹果也调整了 macOS 界面，使菜单等控件能够根据触控或触控板操作作出变化。 报道称，新机可能继续搭载 M5 Pro 和 M5 Max 芯片，升级重点集中在屏幕与交互体验。受 OLED 面板成本影响，售价也可能高于现款，现有 mini-LED 版本预计会继续销售一段时间。目前苹果尚未确认发布会安排及上述产品信息。（来源：IT 之家） 索尼申请游戏无障碍技术专利，拟将脚步声、枪声转为画面提示 10 月 25 日，据 cnBeta 报道，索尼近日公布的一项专利申请提出，将游戏中的脚步声、枪声、爆炸声等转化为屏幕上的视觉提示，帮助失聪及听障玩家获取原本依赖听觉判断的环境信息。 这项技术不只是为角色语音添加字幕。按照专利描述，系统还可以用箭头、图标或颜色变化，提示声音来自哪个方向、距离有多远、强弱如何。例如敌人从身后靠近时，画面边缘可以出现相应提示；玩家也能调整提示的颜色、大小和显示位置。 目前，这仍停留在专利申请阶段。索尼尚未宣布将其用于 PlayStation 或具体游戏，最终能否成为实际功能还有待观察。（来源：cnBeta） 苹果发布 iPhone Duo 支持文档，帮助用户排查铰链和屏幕问题 10 月 25 日，苹果为 iPhone Duo 折叠屏手机发布一批支持文档，其中最值得关注的是排除铰链故障指南。 苹果这份指南中列明，用户需留意 iPhone Duo 无法完全打开或关闭、折叠时发出异常声音，以及铰链松动等情况。苹果建议用户先取下保护壳或屏幕保护膜，接下来检查铰链是否能让手机稳定悬停在不同角度，或查看是否有污垢或灰尘卡在其中，然后用柔软、微湿且不起毛的布清洁屏幕。 该指南还明确指出，这类硬件问题无法通过软件修复。清洁屏幕务必拔掉所有线缆并关闭手机。请勿使用含有漂白剂或过氧化氢的产品，切勿将 iPhone 浸入任何清洁剂中。如果问题仍然无法解决，用户需更换内部显示组件。（来源：IT 之家） 《流浪地球 3》锁定 2027 春节档，片方预告新物料即将上线 10 月 25 日，备受关注的科幻电影《流浪地球 3》亮相全国影片推介会，该片已定档 2027 年大年初一，官方表示很快会放出全新物料。本片依旧由郭帆担任导演，属于《流浪地球》系列的终章，拆分为上下两部制作。上部定档 2027 年大年初一登陆春节档，下部后续择期上映。 故事延续之前的世界观，流浪地球计划继续向前推进，人类要面对宇宙当中接踵而至的危机。 这次在推介会上，片方没有放出完整预告片，只是对外预告新物料快要来了。网上不少影迷已经开始猜测，有可能是海报、先导短片，也有可能是正式预告。 据了解，第三部剧本已经完成，剧组也已经完成拍摄，现在处在后期制作阶段。（来源：cnBeta）
